items.story:
On accelerating advanced process expansion and growing CMP complexity, we lift our
‘27/28E EPS by ~3% to NT$26.03/36.59. We reiterate our Buy rating with PO raised to 
NT$1,050 (vs. NT$800 prior) on 32x 2H27-1H28E P/E (vs. 32x ’27E P/E prior) on better 
visibility of its customers’ new capacity ramp. Upside could come from the ramp of its
grinding wheels at the expense of Disco for advanced packaging applications from 2H27.

grinding wheels at the expense of Disco for advanced packaging applications from 2H27.
